name: harness-scaffold
title_zh: 新项目目录自带一套规格追踪脚手架
tagline_zh: 每次开新项目都要手动拷 spec.py、模板和 skills 文件夹，漏一个就跑不起来。
tagline_en: Every new project meant hand-copying spec.py, the template and the skills folder — miss one and nothing runs.
desc_en: Set up a new project directory with its own copy of the spec harness — the spec.py CLI, the template, the skills and the specs folder. Use when starting a new project that should track its own specs.
why_zh: 不是全局安装，而是每个项目一份独立副本：spec.py、模板、skills、specs 目录一次到位。
why_en: Not a global install — each project gets its own copy of spec.py, template, skills and specs folder, so projects never.
limit_zh: 只负责铺目录和拷文件，不写你的第一条 spec，也不接管已有项目的规格迁移；目标目录非空时行为要自己确认。
limit_en: Only scaffolds the directory and copies files — it won't write your first spec or migrate an existing project's specs, and won't merge into a.
title_en: New project dirs get their own spec-tracking scaffold
